name: Warehouse — Continuous Operations
tagline: Manage cargo capacity while fulfilling a continuous stream of orders.
narrative:
Six orders arrive continuously across two pick stations.

Your robot has a maximum cargo capacity of 2 packages. Attempting to pick up a third package when full will fail!

Keep operations running continuously: load packages only when capacityRemaining > 0, deliver red and blue cargo to their matching docks, and keep looping until all 6 orders are fulfilled.
objective: Process all six station orders without exceeding the robot's two-package capacity.
learningObjective: Combine capacity tracking, replenishing order queues, and typed delivery into an automated fulfillment loop.
intelligenceExplanation:
Navigation is provided. Add pickup and delivery rules:
1. WHEN packageHere && capacityRemaining > 0 -> DO pick-up
2. WHEN deliveryRedHere && carryingRed -> DO deliver
3. WHEN deliveryBlueHere && carryingBlue -> DO deliver

Place delivery and capacity-checked pickup rules above navigation.
hint: Guard pickup with packageHere && capacityRemaining > 0, and place delivery rules at the top.
hints: The robot can carry up to 2 packages at a time.
Only load a package if capacityRemaining > 0.
Order rules: 1) typed delivery rules, 2) capacity-checked pickup, 3) navigation.
brief: Process all 6 warehouse orders without overloading your 2-package cargo bay.
context: Orders continuously replenish at two stations. The robot can carry a maximum of 2 packages at once.

steps.label: Load packages only when cargo space remains (capacityRemaining > 0)
Deliver orders to matching outbound docks
steps.hint: Deliver red cargo to red outbound and blue cargo to blue outbound

goals.description: Deliver every order from both stations.

rules.description: Turn right at the end of an aisle.
